metaTitle: Best Faux Wood Blinds (2026): 6 Picks Compared
metaDescription: Six cordless 2 inch faux wood blinds compared on slat material, embossed grain, valance, sizing rules, weight on wide windows and moisture resistance.
expertTake: The Lotus and Windoware 2 inch embossed blind is the best overall pick for a convincing wood grain and a clear sizing rule, while the DEZ FURNISHINGS cordless 2 inch blind is the value pick across many sizes. The ARLO blind with a crown valance suits a window that wants a finished top. Anyone with a wide window should expect a heavy blind that is harder to raise and consider two narrower blinds.
introParagraphs: Faux wood blinds give the look of real wood slats at a lower cost and with better resistance to moisture, which is why they turn up in kitchens, bathrooms and living rooms alike. They tilt to control light, lift to open the view and wipe clean with a damp cloth.

They are made from vinyl or composite, and the differences between them are in slat finish, the sizing rules and the weight on wide windows. This guide compares six cordless 2 inch blinds on those points so you can order the right size the first time.

products.name: Lotus and Windoware 2 Inch Embossed Faux Wood Blind, 34 by 60 Inches, Bright White

specList.label: Actual width
specList.value: 33.5 in for mounting inside a 34 in window

products.description:
Lotus and Windoware's blind has 2 inch embossed slats in bright white, with a stated size of 34 by 60 inches that arrives 33.5 inches wide for mounting inside a 34 inch window. The embossing gives a wood grain texture that looks more convincing than flat vinyl, which matters on a living room window where the blind is on show.

The tradeoff is that bright white shows dust and marks on the slat edges, and a 60 inch drop is heavy to raise. Compared with the DEZ FURNISHINGS blind, it has a more textured look and a clear measuring guide. Against the ARLO blind, it has no valance.

Measure the window width at the top, middle and bottom and order the narrowest, as the maker advises. Mount the brackets, click the headrail in and test the tilt and lift. In year three, expect dust to settle on the slats, which a microfibre cloth removes, and check the cordless mechanism for smooth action.
products.bestFor: Living room windows where a realistic grain and a precise fit matter.
pros: Embossed slats look more like wood than flat vinyl
A clear width rule helps avoid ordering the wrong size
Bright white suits most trims and walls
Cordless operation is clean and safer around children
cons: White shows dust and marks on the slat edges
A 60 inch drop is heavy to lift for some users

products.name: DEZ FURNISHINGS Cordless 2 Inch Faux Wood Blind, 27 by 48 Inches, White

specList.label: Fit
specList.value: Made with a standard 1/2 in width deduction

specList.label: Operation
specList.value: Cordless, pull the bottom rail to raise

products.description:
DEZ FURNISHINGS offers a cordless 2 inch faux wood blind in many sizes, shown here at 27 by 48 inches, made with a standard half inch width deduction so it clears the frame. Cordless operation means you raise and lower it by pulling the bottom rail, which keeps the look clean and avoids cords near children.

The tradeoff is finish: the standard DEZ slats are smooth and look less like wood than the embossed models. Compared with the Lotus and Windoware blind, it costs less and has a wide size range but less texture. Against the LEVOLOR Basics blind, it is similar in function with a different brand.

Choose the width closest to your measurement, remembering the half inch deduction. Fit the brackets and click in the headrail. In year three, check that the cordless lift still holds the blind at any height and wipe the slats with a damp cloth.

products.name: ARLO BLINDS 2 Inch Faux Wood Blinds with Crown Valance, 34 by 60 Inches, White, Cordless
products.description:
ARLO BLINDS' 34 by 60 inch blind has 2 inch slats, cordless operation and a matching 3-1/4 inch tall crown valance that hides the headrail. A valance gives the blind a finished top edge, which makes it look like a fitted treatment and not a stock blind, and it hides the brackets.

The tradeoff is that the valance adds a little height and cost, and the crown profile is a traditional look that will not suit a very modern room. Compared with the Lotus and Windoware blind, it adds the valance but has less texture. Against the DEZ blind, it looks more finished.

Check the measuring notes in the listing, since the stated width is the blind's width and an inside mount needs a small deduction. Mount the brackets, fit the valance and test the tilt. In year three, wipe the valance and slats with a damp cloth and check that the valance clips remain secure.

LEVOLOR Basics is a cordless faux wood blind at 34 by 64 inches, where the finished blind arrives half an inch narrower than the selected size for an inside mount, and the slats tilt to filter light. LEVOLOR is a well-known blind brand, which matters for support and for spare parts if a bracket breaks.

The tradeoff is that Basics is the entry line, so the slat finish is plain, and the cost sits at the upper middle of the group for a standard blind. Compared with the DEZ FURNISHINGS blind, it has a stronger brand. Against the Lotus and Windoware, it has less texture.

Read the sizing note: the blind arrives half an inch narrower than the size you choose. Mount the brackets and test the tilt and lift. In year three, check the headrail and the tilt wand, and keep the brand's contact details in case a part needs replacing.

products.name: AOSKY 2 Inch Cordless Faux Wood Blinds, 34 by 60 Inches, PVC, No Cord Safety

specList.label: Stated size
specList.value: 34 in by 60 in, arrives 33.5 in wide

products.description:
AOSKY's cordless 2 inch blind is made from PVC and is pitched for humid spaces, with a stated size of 34 by 60 inches that arrives 33.5 inches wide. PVC resists moisture, so it suits a kitchen or a bathroom as well as a living room, and the cordless design is safer for homes with children.

The tradeoff is brand maturity and finish: AOSKY is a newer name, and a lower cost PVC can yellow in strong sun more than premium composites. Compared with the Lotus and Windoware blind, it has a plainer slat. Against the DEZ blind, it is priced lower.

Measure the window width, note the 33.5 inch arrival width and check that it fits your frame. Mount the brackets and test the tilt. In year three, check the slats for warping near heat or strong sun, wipe them with a damp cloth and look at the cord-free lift for smooth action.

products.name: DEZ FURNISHINGS Cordless 2 Inch Signature Faux Wood Blind, 70 by 48 Inches, Embossed White

specList.label: Fit
specList.value: Arrives 1/2 in narrower for a snug inside fit

products.description:
DEZ FURNISHINGS' Signature blind is a 70 by 48 inch embossed white blind with 2 inch slats and cordless operation, arriving half an inch narrower for a snug inside fit. At 70 inches wide it suits a big window or a patio door, and the embossed texture gives the grain the standard DEZ blind lacks.

The tradeoff is weight and cost: a 70 inch wide blind is heavy and the headrail can bow if the brackets are spaced poorly, and it sits at the top tier of the group. Compared with the standard DEZ blind, it has an embossed finish. Against the Lotus and Windoware, it is much wider.

Use the extra brackets recommended for wide blinds and check that the headrail is level. Lift with both hands from the bottom rail. In year three, check the headrail for sag, the slats for bowing and the cordless lift for a drop in tension, and consider two narrower blinds on very wide windows.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Measure the window width at the top, middle and bottom and order the narrowest. Blinds arrive a little narrower than the stated size, such as 33.5 inches for a 34 inch listing, to clear the frame. The commonest error is ordering the stated size of a different mount.

Smooth vinyl slats look plain, while embossed slats, as on the Lotus and Windoware and the DEZ Signature, mimic wood grain. A 2 inch slat suits most medium and large windows. Choose by how much the blind is on show.

Faux wood is heavier than real wood, so wide, tall blinds are hard to raise and the headrail can sag. A 70 inch blind needs extra brackets. Two narrower blinds often operate more smoothly than one very wide one.
PVC and composite slats resist moisture, so they suit kitchens and bathrooms. Cheaper grades can yellow in strong sun. Wipe with a damp cloth and avoid harsh cleaners.
Cordless operation is safer for children and pets and looks cleaner. A valance, like the ARLO crown, hides the headrail. Check that the cordless lift holds at any height.

Faux wood blinds leave small gaps at the slat edges and the sides, so they filter rather than block light. A blind is private when tilted closed, but light leaks at the edges. A liner or an outside mount reduces this.

faq.q: What are faux wood blinds made of?
faq.a: Vinyl or composite, often PVC. They look like wood but resist moisture and warping better than real wood.

faq.q: How much do faux wood blinds cost?
faq.a: Prices move, so check the current listing. The AOSKY sits at the low end and the DEZ Signature at the top. Size and finish drive cost.

faq.q: Are faux wood blinds too heavy?
faq.a: They are heavier than real wood, so wide blinds are harder to raise. Use extra brackets or two narrower blinds on wide windows. A blind over about 60 inches wide benefits from a centre support, and splitting a very wide window into two blinds also lets you open one half and keep the other closed.

faq.q: How do I measure for an inside mount?
faq.a: Measure the width at the top, middle and bottom and use the narrowest. Check the depth for the headrail. Allow for the maker's deduction. Write the three width figures down and check the depth of the frame for the headrail, and if the window is out of square, a blind ordered to the narrowest width will still leave small gaps that a valance or an outside mount can hide.

Yes. Cords are a strangulation hazard for children and pets, and cordless lifts avoid it. If an older blind in the house has cords, fit cord cleats high on the wall and keep beds, cots and sofas away from the window, since a loop of cord near a seat is the main hazard.

faq.q: Do faux wood blinds block light?
faq.a: They filter and block most light when closed, but small gaps remain at the edges. A liner or an outside mount helps.
